summary.text: Lori Dittman, listed by Ballotpedia as Lori Cowger Dittman, is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates for District 63, which she has represented since December 2022, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. She is a teacher and small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Lori Dittman graduated from Braxton County High School and earned degrees from Fairmont State College and West Virginia University.
Her career experience includes working as a teacher and small business owner.
Dittman took office in the House of Delegates on December 1, 2022, succeeding Republican John Hardy, and advanced from the Republican primary on May 12, 2026.
